mapper.sql: SELECT t.id,t.member_id AS publisherMemberId,SUBSTRING(t.name,1,257) AS name,t.product_type AS productType, t.config_version AS configVersion,t.del_flag AS delFlag,r.id AS roleId,r.topic_id AS roleTopicId, r.slot AS roleSlot,r.entity_type AS entityType,r.entity_id AS entityId,r.status AS roleStatus,r.declared_by AS declaredBy,r.created_at AS createdAt FROM cms_topic t JOIN product_role r ON r.topic_id=t.id AND r.slot='CONTENT' AND r.status=1 WHERE t.del_flag=0 AND t.member_id=#{actor} AND r.entity_type='MEMBER' AND r.entity_id=#{actor} AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product_role active_role WHERE active_role.topic_id=t.id AND active_role.slot='CONTENT' AND active_role.status=1)=1
mapper.select: AND t.id < #{before} ORDER BY t.id DESC LIMIT 51
